rules.policy_title: 2026 Evolent Clinical Guidelines for Medical Necessity Review: Advanced Imaging Guidelines (v2)
rules.source_file: rulebook_collection/domains/advanced_imaging/policy_pdfs/current_2026/2026 Evolent Clinical Guidelines - Advanced Imaging v2.pdf
rules.source_quote: Acute, sudden onset headache (< 4 weeks), with any ONE of the following: ○ A personal or family history (brother, sister, parent, or child) of brain aneurysm or AVM (arteriovenous malformation) ○ < 48 hours of “worst headache in my life” or “thunderclap” headache (Sudden onset new headache reaching maximum intensity within 2-3 minutes, lasting more than 5 minutes) ○ Prior history of stroke or intracranial bleed ○ Known coagulopathy or on anticoagulation

criteria.description: Acute sudden onset headache with duration less than 4 weeks
At least one high-risk vascular or intracranial red flag feature present
Personal or first-degree family history of brain aneurysm or AVM
Thunderclap onset or worst headache of life within 48 hours
Prior history of stroke or intracranial bleed
Known coagulopathy or currently on active anticoagulation therapy

required_documentation: Neurology or ED consultation notes detailing headache onset and duration
Medication list or family history notes documenting specific high risk feature
rules.review_notes: Emergency and acute high-risk headache indication for Brain MRI.

rules.policy_title: 2026 Evolent Clinical Guidelines for Medical Necessity Review: Advanced Imaging Guidelines (v2)
rules.source_file: rulebook_collection/domains/advanced_imaging/policy_pdfs/current_2026/2026 Evolent Clinical Guidelines - Advanced Imaging v2.pdf
rules.source_section: Additional Indications in the Pediatric Population (<18) When None of the Above Apply
rules.source_quote: Persistent headache and any ONE of the following (8–10): ○ Immune deficiency ○ History of neoplasm ○ History of congenital heart disease ○ See Imaging in Known Genetic Conditions for additional indications ○ Coagulopathy ○ Occipital location ○ Age < 6 years

criteria.description: Patient age strictly less than 18 years
At least one pediatric red flag condition present

required_documentation: Pediatrician or pediatric neurologist clinical consultation note
Medical history validating presence of red flag feature

rules.source_file: rulebook_collection/domains/advanced_imaging/policy_pdfs/current_2026/2026 Evolent Clinical Guidelines - Advanced Imaging v2.pdf
rules.source_section: INDICATIONS / Multiple Sclerosis / Evaluation of Suspected Multiple Sclerosis (61,62)

criteria.description: Clinical presentation suspicious for CNS demyelinating disease (e.g. optic neuritis, acute transverse myelitis, brainstem/cerebellar syndrome) or surveillance of established Multiple Sclerosis

required_documentation: Neurology clinic notes documenting demyelinating signs, prior CSF oligoclonal bands, or DMT therapy monitoring
rules.review_notes: Brain MRI with/without contrast indicated for multiple sclerosis diagnosis and monitoring.

rules.source_file: rulebook_collection/domains/advanced_imaging/policy_pdfs/current_2026/2026 Evolent Clinical Guidelines - Advanced Imaging v2.pdf
rules.source_section: INDICATIONS / Seizure Disorders / Evaluation of Known or Suspected Seizure Disorder (54–60)
rules.source_quote: New onset of an unprovoked seizure

criteria.description: Patient has experienced a new-onset unprovoked seizure
Patient has medically refractory epilepsy or newly identified change in seizure semiology

required_documentation: Neurology consultation notes and EEG findings documenting seizure semiology
rules.review_notes: Brain MRI is the primary modality for unprovoked seizures and epilepsy.
